headings.leadersBlurb: These four are the automatic NFC seeds. Everyone else is chasing the three wild cards.
headings.pathsBlurb: Win the NFC North, or be one of the three best remaining clubs in the conference. The closer route is the one that matters.
headings.footer: Updated from ESPN’s public NFL feeds. Not affiliated with the NFL, the Green Bay Packers, or ESPN.
headings.footerTiny: Seven NFC teams qualify: four division winners and three wild cards. The playoff percentage is a season simulation from point differential and home field. It is not a betting line.
headings.conclusion: The Green Bay Packers have been mathematically eliminated from the NFL playoffs.
headings.injuryBlurb: Packers listed as injured or on injured reserve. A Tuesday practice note can move before Sunday.
headings.rootingBlurb: Who needs to lose for the division or the cut line to get closer. Not a betting line, and not a live in-game number.
